ios.desc:
Safari keeps every open tab running: its scripts, its video, its connections. Tab Suspender puts the ones you're not using to sleep, freeing up to 60% of the memory they hold.

Click or tap a sleeping tab and the page comes straight back, at the same scroll position.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose how long a tab may sit idle, from a minute to eight hours. After that it goes to sleep on its own.
• A sleeping tab keeps its address, its title and its icon, and shows roughly how much memory it handed back.
• A sleeping tab runs nothing: no scripts, no timers, no video.
• Put a tab to sleep yourself, send every other tab to sleep at once, or wake them all. On the Mac there are keyboard shortcuts too.

NEVER THE TAB YOU'RE USING
Tabs you're typing in, tabs playing audio and pinned tabs stay awake, and so does the tab in front of you.

NOTHING LOST
• Sleeping tabs keep their place in history, so Back still works.
• A sleeping tab is still an ordinary Safari tab, so it reaches your other devices through iCloud Tabs.

PREMIUM
• Deep sleep: frees far more memory by parking the tab on a blank page of ours, and keeps it asleep when you quit Safari. The page's address never leaves your browser.
• Stats: how many tabs slept and how much memory they freed, day by day.
• Never-suspend lists for sites and pages that must always stay awake.
• Wake a tab the moment you open it, or keep every tab awake while you're plugged in.
• A blurred screenshot of the page behind each sleeping tab.

Premium is a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase. Bought the original Tab Suspender years ago? Premium is already yours: use Restore Purchases in the app.

No ads, no account.
